d:
I used to fxp on Apostle's works for a long time, and especially loving his coloring/shading/Western-Japanese blend style..
Since he deleted his blog & stopped posting, I haven't seen his new work for around several years (except some upscale/recolor/futarization works made by 3rd party) so I download a LoRa and recreate counterfeit version of his art.
The line/color are kinda unstable and eyes may vary a bit（maybe due to character eyes'design affected the Apostle style）. But I think they're suffice to be as fxpping materials.
3/16:added 3 Niko pictures to make story whole. Fixed P2

以前我经常用Apostle的大作当作施法材料，尤其喜欢他的色彩和光影以及西式+日式的混合风格。
自从他删除博客停止更新后，我已经好几年没看到他的新作了（除了一些第三方制作的高清版/上色版/扶她版之类的），因此我下载了对应LoRA并尽可能模仿他的风格。
目前来看线条和上色还是有些不稳定，眼睛也会有些变化（猜测是人物本身的眼睛设计和Apostle的风格撞车）。不过以我来看已经达到了能撸的水平了。
